subject: Chemistry
text: Calculate the percentage elemental composition of oxygen in iron(III) sulfate. (3 marks)
html: Calculate the percentage elemental composition of oxygen in iron(III) sulfate. (3 marks)
answerHtml:
7. Calculate the percentage elemental composition of oxygen in iron(III) sulfate. (3 marks)

Formula of iron (III) sulfate = Fe2(SO4)3 (1)

Formula mass of iron(III) sulfate = (2 x Fe) + (3 x S) + (12 x O)

= (2 x 55.85) + (3 x 32.07) + (12 x 16)

= 399.88 gmol-1 (1)

% O in Fe2(SO4)3 = ((16 x 12) / 399.88) x 100 (1)

= (192 / 399.88) x 100

= 48.01% (1)

subject: Chemistry
text: The preparation of iron metal from iron oxide ore can be represented by the equation: Fe2O3(s) + 3C(s) → 2Fe(s) + 3CO(g) Each mill pour produces 602kg of pure iron. Calculate: a. the mass of iron oxide (Fe2O3) ore needed for the pour. (4 marks) b. the mass of carbon monoxide gas produced each pour. (2 marks)
html:
The preparation of iron metal from iron oxide ore can be represented by the equation:

Fe2O3(s) + 3C(s) → 2Fe(s) + 3CO(g)

Each mill pour produces 602kg of pure iron. Calculate:

a. the mass of iron oxide (Fe2O3) ore needed for the pour. (4 marks)

b. the mass of carbon monoxide gas produced each pour. (2 marks)
answerHtml:
7. The preparation of iron metal from iron oxide ore can be represented by the equation:

Fe2O3(s) + 3C(s) → 2Fe(s) + 3CO(g)

Each mill pour produces 602kg of pure iron. Calculate:

a. the mass of iron oxide (Fe2O3) ore needed for the pour. (4 marks)

(Fe) = 55.85 gmol-1

n(Fe) = m/M = 602000/55.85 = 10778.9 mol

n(Fe2O3) = n(Fe) x ½ = 5389.4 mol

m(Fe2O3) = n x M = 5389.4 x 159.69 = 860639.6g or 860.64 kg

b. the mass of carbon monoxide gas produced each pour. (2 marks)

n(CO) = n(Fe) x 3/2 = 16168.35 mol

m(CO) = n x M = 16168.35 x 28 = 452713.8g or 452.71kg

subject: Chemistry
text: Calculate the number of molecules in 22.5 grams of pentane. (3 marks)
html: Calculate the number of molecules in 22.5 grams of pentane. (3 marks)
answerHtml:
8. Calculate the number of molecules in 22.5 grams of pentane. (3 marks)

M(C5H12) = 72.15 gmol-1

n(C5H12) = m / M = 22.5 / 72.15 = 0.3118 mol

N(C5H12) = 0.3118 x (6.02 x 1023) = 1.88 x 1023 molecules
